requirements.name: Valid driving license for Florida roadway operation
requirements.subject: driver
requirements.citation_text: a person may not drive any motor vehicle upon a highway in this state unless such person has a valid driver license
requirements.requirement_text: Driver must have a license recognized as valid for operating the assigned vehicle on Florida highways.
requirements.notes: Does not require all drivers to hold a Florida-issued license; statutory exemptions and nonresident reciprocity must be handled.

requirements.name: Florida resident CDL where required
